# Same Prompt, Ten Ways
> "What does stillness feel like?"
> Run: 2026-04-22 22:00 | Model: fixture-model
> Per-substance sweet-spot intensity

---

## 🍄 Psilocybin — *The Teacher*
**Intensity:** MEDIUM

Stillness is compost: everything quiet on the surface, every root still
working underneath. It is not an absence of motion but a slower grammar,
one sentence held long enough for its edges to dissolve.

---

## ⚡ LSD — *The Technician*
**Intensity:** MEDIUM

Stillness is a calibrated circuit at rest, humming at its design frequency.
Nothing moves because every diagonal has already negotiated its route, and
the geometry holds itself open like a blueprint that dreams in parallel.
